# DMT Receipts

> Local stdio MCP server and browser demo for five-field `dmt-memory/v1` agent memories. `prepare_memory` returns a TAP/Ordinals inscription payload and SHA-256. `verify_inscription` recomputes that digest and can compare public inscription bytes. Permanence is the inscribed Bitcoin content. After prepare, status is `prepared`. A wallet or Ordinals tool inscribes and pays fees separately.

Repository show-and-tell for agents. Byte rules for the five fields (`agent_id`, `key`, `content`, `tags`, `created_at`) stay on the live protocol recipe. Optional extension fields are kept and hashed. This file does not redefine canonicalization.

## Run

Node.js 18+. `npm ci` builds `dist/index.js`. `npm run typecheck` runs `tsc --noEmit`. The demo calls both tools on a fixed memory and checks the published digest.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Colchora/dmt-receipts.git
cd dmt-receipts
npm ci
node examples/run-demo.mjs
```

Expected: `sha256` `76f3f9ff531cecbfe46e676e932f9b0d9d02b3d7c04e5a558924a8092cb0294b`, `byte_length` 170, `status` `prepared`, `matches_expected_sha256` true, `ok` false. `ok` stays false until `inscription_id` points at inscription content that matches those bytes.

The server speaks MCP on stdin. Start it from an MCP client. A bare `node dist/index.js` waits for that client.

## MCP

Cursor, after `npm ci`, uses `.cursor/mcp.json`. `${workspaceFolder}` is the directory that contains that file.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dmt-receipts": {
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["${workspaceFolder}/dist/index.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Desktop and other clients:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "dmt-receipts": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["/absolute/path/to/dmt-receipts/dist/index.js"]
    }
  }
}
```

Call `prepare_memory` with `examples/demo-memory.json`. Pass the returned `memory` and `sha256` to `verify_inscription` with `fetch_content` false and `include_trac` false until an inscription exists.

## Tools

- `prepare_memory` — required `agent_id`, `key`, `content`. Optional `tags` (string array, default `[]`) and `created_at` (ISO-8601 UTC, whole seconds, ending in `Z`; default is the current UTC second). Returns `memory`, `canonical`, `sha256`, `byte_length`, `status` `prepared`, and `inscription_recipe` (`content_utf8` plus optional TAP `dta`).
- `verify_inscription` — required `memory` (the five fields, plus any extensions). Optional `inscription_id`, `txid`, `sha256`, `fetch_content` (default true when `inscription_id` is set), `include_trac` (default true when `inscription_id` is set), `trac_rest_base`. Returns the recomputed digest, explorer links, and a content-fetch result.

- [Demo memory](examples/demo-memory.json): five-field input with a fixed timestamp
